title: Content Automation Engine
description: Autonomous AI-powered content generation, thumbnail rendering, metadata tagging, and programmatic multi-platform distribution.
overview: Architected an end-to-end automated content engine that generates video concepts, generates assets, compiles final social reels, and schedules publication.
challenge: Producing high volumes of omnichannel technical content weekly without burning out editorial teams in manual export and captioning loops.
solution: Built a Python & n8n orchestration using Gemini 2.5 Flash for script expansion and FFmpeg on Cloud Run for dynamic rendering and automated uploads.
